---
title: "Palmer Penguins"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
# select variable
selectInput(
  inputId = 'variable', 
  label = 'Select variable:',
  choices = colnames(penguins)[3:6],
  selected = "bill_length_m")

# choose transparency value
sliderInput(
  inputId = "alpha", 
  label = "Opacity (alpha):",
  min = 0,
  max = 1,
  value = 0.5)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Distributions"
plotOutput(outputId = 'plot')
```


```{r}
#| context: server
output$plot <- renderPlot({
  ggplot(data = penguins, 
         aes(x = .data[[input$variable]], 
             fill = species)) +
    geom_density(alpha = input$alpha) +
    theme_minimal()
})
```
